title: Payment-Standing Discount on ClearPath Standard Upgrades
content:
**Rule.** The payment-standing discount on the upgraded rate of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement moving from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard counts the late fees posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today): none takes 2.0 percent off; exactly one takes 1.0 percent off; two or more take nothing off.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. Late fees are the late fee entries on the agreement's billing ledger, counted by posting date.

| Late fees in the last 12 months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 | 2.0 percent |
| 1 | 1.0 percent |
| 2 or more | nothing |
